verdict.rationale: Polar's first-party docs describe no-code Checkout Links that are configured once in the dashboard and shared as a URL anywhere, with Polar handling the rest. As Merchant of Record with a free self-serve Starter plan, Polar lets a founder begin selling without building payment infrastructure. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard link-creation flow and time-to-first-sale.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Configure once in the dashboard, share the URL anywhere (your website, social media, email, a button in your app), and Polar handles the rest.
Three documented checkout surfaces: no-code Checkout Links
Sell digital products, subscriptions, and more without the hassle of traditional payment systems.
